name: changelog
title: Changelog
description: Changelog with markdown file support and GitHub commit fallback, timeline view, and individual entry pages.
docs: Auto-generated changelog from your GitHub repo's commits and tags. Set `GITHUB_REPO_OWNER` and `GITHUB_REPO_NAME` env vars (defaults to lacymorrow/shipkit). Optionally set `GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN` for higher API rate limits.
